items.zh_full: 《自然·光子学》于2026年10月30日在线发表的一篇研究，报道了硬X射线阿秒脉冲的测量进展。自由电子激光科学中，高功率X射线阿秒脉冲的产生与表征是极具挑战性的前沿课题。来自美国林纳克相干光源（Linac Coherent Light Source）的研究人员，通过实验证实并测量了持续时间达到100阿秒的硬X射线脉冲。这一结果标志着在硬X射线波段实现阿秒级脉冲的生成与诊断取得了重要进展。阿秒脉冲能够为研究原子、分子内部超快电子动力学提供前所未有的时间分辨率工具。此前，X射线自由电子激光的脉冲长度通常处于飞秒量级，而此次实验将硬X射线脉冲压缩至百阿秒水平，并完成了相应的测量表征。论文详细描述了产生与测量方法，包括脉冲的生成机制以及用于确认脉冲持续时间的诊断技术。该工作为未来在X射线波段开展阿秒时间分辨实验奠定了基础。

items.summary: The principle "Work smarter, not harder!" apparently also applies to controlling quantum materials with light. Many of their fascinating properties depend on how the atoms are arranged in the crystal. Ultrashort laser pulses can be used to alter these structures in a targeted way—the light first excites electrons, whose changed energy and dynamics exert forces on the atomic nuclei and can thereby set the atoms in motion. Such processes unfold within femtoseconds, a millionth of a billionth of a second.

items.title: After 40 years of the ‘green problem,’ the quiet laser explains itself
items.summary: Intracavity-doubled green lasers within thousands of laboratories have been quiet for years without anyone knowing why. The answer is the opposite of the obvious one: A nonlinear crystal makes every mode noisier, but the total goes quiet anyway.
items.zh_full: 在数以千计的实验室中，腔内倍频绿激光器多年来一直安静地工作，却无人知晓原因。非线性晶体实际上让每个模式都变得更嘈杂，但总噪声却反而降低了。这一发现解释了长期存在的“绿光问题”——绿激光器在特定条件下表现出异常低的噪声，此前一直缺乏理论解释。研究表明，倍频过程中的非线性相互作用使得各纵模的强度涨落相互关联，导致总强度噪声被抑制。这一机理不仅澄清了四十年的谜题，也为设计低噪声绿光激光器提供了新的理论指导，可能影响光谱学、全息成像等精密应用。

items.title: Quantum dot lasers may unlock next era of AI optical interconnects
items.summary: A misconception about quantum dot lasers (QDLs) is they’re poised to replace indium phosphide (InP) technology. But InP externally modulated lasers (EMLs) will continue serving optical networking and datacom applications, while QDLs emerge for applications that require power efficiency, thermal resilience, and integration density.
items.zh_full: 关于量子点激光器（QDLs）的一个常见误解是它们将取代磷化铟（InP）技术。实际上，InP外调制激光器（EMLs）将继续服务于光网络和数据通信应用，而QDLs则面向需要功率效率、热稳定性和集成密度的新兴应用。量子点激光器因其量子限制效应，在高温下具有更低的阈值电流和更好的温度稳定性，同时支持更高密度的单片集成。这些特性使其特别适合AI光互连场景，其中能效和散热是关键约束。然而，InP EMLs在现有光通信基础设施中仍具有成熟性能和成本优势，短期内不会被完全替代。两种技术将并行发展，各自服务于不同的应用需求。

items.summary: As quantum computers grow more ambitious, many researchers believe the best way forward is to build them in multiple interconnected parts. In these modular designs, separate quantum processors are linked so they can work together as one larger machine. For this to happen, however, connections must carry fragile quantum information without destroying it.

items.title: Quantum skyrmions outlast entanglement, hinting at more resilient networks
items.summary: Quantum networks could one day connect quantum computers into more powerful systems and enable new forms of secure communication. items.title: How the quantum vacuum perturbs atoms, could shrink black holes and may have helped form galaxies
items.summary: The word "vacuum" may conjure the image of empty space. Maybe you think of a region far outside the solar system without planets, debris, gas clouds or light. According to quantum theory, however, a vacuum is never truly empty. Quantum mechanics extends the Heisenberg uncertainty principle—which states that we cannot measure the position and the velocity of an object exactly at the same time—to a vacuum. The result is that a vacuum can never be still.
items.zh_full: “真空”一词可能让人联想到空无一物的空间，比如太阳系外没有行星、碎片、气体云或光线的区域。然而，根据量子理论，真空从来不是真正空的。量子力学将海森堡不确定性原理——该原理指出我们无法同时精确测量一个物体的位置和速度——扩展到真空中。结果是，真空永远不可能静止。这一量子真空扰动对原子、黑洞和星系形成都有深远影响。量子真空中的涨落会扰动原子，可能使黑洞收缩，并可能帮助星系形成。这些效应源于真空零点能的涨落，它们改变了我们对宇宙基本过程的理解。
items.llm_summary: 量子理论表明真空并非真正空无一物，而是充满涨落。这些量子真空扰动会影响原子行为、可能导致黑洞收缩，并可能对星系形成起到作用。

items.title: Guarding the Gates of Knowledge
items.summary: A recent scroll through social media got me thinking about trust. About half my feed was filled with AI slop that astute users would call out as being machine-generated, often to the embarrassment of the rube who unknowingly spread it and sometimes to the delight of the poster who shared it deliberately because they found it amusing or useful for sowing confusion. Remember the good old days of GPT-3 when we could ask the chatbot anything and it would almost instantly and very confidently spit back a plausible but false answer? That’s when the word “hallucination” as applied to AI answers entered the lexicon. Six years and several versions of a few different chatbots later, I still can’t trust the answers I get, even though Claude or Gemini often do useful work for me. That’s the thing about current AI: Trust but verify. And verify you must. Apply that maxim at scale to maintain the integrity of the scientific record and you get an idea of the challenge facing publishers of peer-reviewed scholarship. In “ I Used AI to Fake a Scientific Paper ,” freelance writer and doctor of applied mathematics Benjamin Skuse tells the story of the human gatekeepers trying to beat back the rising tide of AI slop by attempting to get his own AI-generated papers past IEEE’s defenses. “He basically hit ‘run experiment’ and ‘write paper.’ And then he didn’t do a damn thing to it.” —Eliza Strickland As features and AI beat editor Eliza Strickland told me, Skuse was surprised at just how effortless it was to generate a paper that was more or less plausible and more or less science. For one of his experiments, “he basically hit ‘run experiment’ and ‘write paper,’” she said. “And then he didn’t do a damn thing to it. He just launched it into the maw of the publishing engine.” Skuse discovered that the combination of IEEE’s human-review processes and research-integrity checker programs are currently keeping pace in what amounts to a cat-and-mouse game against people using free tools. But the more advanced LLMs are no longer making the same dumb mistakes the free versions do. items.summary: Vincent van Gogh captured the pre-dawn sky for his iconic painting—in terms of observation and shape when a waning crescent moon, Venus, and the Hyades star cluster appeared close together—so accurately that it led scientists to the exact spot he’d stood 130 years earlier, likely on July 22, 1889.

items.title: Shaping light to see deeper inside biological tissue

items.title: 780-nm photobiomodulation advances peripheral nerve repair toward a device-ready clinical platform
items.summary: No drug is approved to speed nerve regeneration for peripheral nerve injury, but four decades of research have established 780-nm continuous-wave photobiomodulation (PBM) as a validated, noninvasive treatment for significant motor recovery. We invite industrial partners to bring a translation-ready platform into clinical use.
